key.tacklebox.dump_gui: dump open gui to file and clipboard
tacklebox.config.accent1.desc: The first colour of the gradient on focused tiles, hovered buttons, toggles and sliders in every screen of the mod.
tacklebox.config.accent2.desc: The second colour of that gradient. use the same as the first for a flat accent.
tacklebox.config.flatMenus.desc: Chests, your inventory and fishonmc menus with no box and no slot boxes, just the items. hides the menu art from the server pack.
tacklebox.config.menuAccent.desc: Fills the fishonmc menu buttons with the accent gradient instead of dark grey.
tacklebox.config.menuAccentOpacity.desc: How strong the accent fill of the menu buttons is. (%)
tacklebox.config.menuBgColor.desc: The colour behind chests, your inventory and fishonmc menus when simple menus is on.
tacklebox.config.menuBgOpacity.desc: How strong that colour is. 0 is see-through. (%)
tacklebox.config.menuImageOpacity.desc: How strong your own picture is behind the menus. 0 hides it. (%)
tacklebox.config.flatButtons.desc: Every button as a flat see-through fill instead of the bevelled texture, in the game menus too.
tacklebox.config.rarityCircles.desc: A see-through circle in the rarity colour behind items in your inventory. foecollabs corner mark has its own setting.
tacklebox.config.fishMenu.desc: The main menu and /travel as a screen with big icons you can rearrange. off gives the chest back.
tacklebox.config.menuSize.desc: How much of the screen the fishonmc menu fills. (%)
tacklebox.config.presetsMenu.desc: /presets as a wardrobe of cards with player models. off gives the chest back.
tacklebox.config.presetsSize.desc: How much of the screen the presets screen fills. (%)
tacklebox.config.presetsOtherBg.desc: Draws the card boxes behind the dimmed presets of the other page. off shows only the models.
tacklebox.config.vaultMenu.desc: /pv as all seven personal vaults on one screen with a search. a vault shows what it held when you last opened it. off gives the chest back.
tacklebox.config.shortFishTooltips.desc: A caught fish with no scientific name, value or ecosystem line, no kg or cm, weight and length on one line and the rarity mark next to the name. only changes what you see.
tacklebox.config.shortPetTooltips.desc: A pet with no line for its kind, no equipped skin, item or trail line when nothing is equipped, no right click hint, and the rarity mark next to the name. only changes what you see.
tacklebox.config.petProfitMarks.desc: In the auction house, a pet you could sell to the pet store for more than it costs gets a green tint, and every pet gets a line with what the store pays. only common and rare pets, the other rarities are not known yet. only changes what you see.
tacklebox.config.hotbarLook.desc: What sits behind the hotbar slots: nothing, the vanilla sprite, a see-through fill, a thin outline or both. the vanilla sprite only fits 20 pixel spacing.
tacklebox.config.hotbarSpacing.desc: The distance between hotbar slots in pixels. 20 is vanilla, 16 puts the items right next to each other. not used by the vanilla sprite look.
tacklebox.config.hotbarScale.desc: How big the hotbar is. it grows from the bottom middle. (%)
tacklebox.config.hotbarSelection.desc: How the slot you hold is marked: the vanilla frame, a round ring, a simple line under the item, or nothing.
tacklebox.config.hotbarSelectColor.desc: The colour of the round ring and the simple line. the frame keeps its own.
tacklebox.config.hotbarOffhand.desc: The box next to the hotbar for your offhand item.
tacklebox.config.equipHud.desc: Your chestplate, leggings and boots and the reel, pole and line of your rod as two rounded groups above the hotbar. off brings back foecollabs own row.
tacklebox.config.equipScale.desc: How big foecollabs armour and rod parts row is. move it with move huds. (%)
tacklebox.config.equipPlace.desc: Where the armour and rod parts row sits: above the hotbar, or level with it on its left or right. you can still drag it from there.
tacklebox.config.equipLook.desc: What sits behind foecollabs armour and rod parts: nothing, foecollabs own squares, or a fill, outline or both around each group of three.
tacklebox.config.equipSpacing.desc: The distance between equipment slots in pixels. 22 is foecollabs own. not used by its own squares look.
tacklebox.config.boxOutlineColor.desc: The colour of the thin outline around the hotbar and equipment boxes.
tacklebox.config.boxOpacity.desc: How strong the accent gradient fill behind the hotbar and equipment is. 0 is see-through. (%)
tacklebox.config.equipCircle.desc: A circle in the rarity colour behind each equipment item, instead of foecollabs bar under it.
tacklebox.config.equipRecolor.desc: Uses one colour for the circle or bar instead of the rarity colour.
tacklebox.config.equipColor.desc: The colour used when equipment colour is on.
tacklebox.config.questsHud.desc: Quests until your next level and the next level of your location. it learns from /menu, /quests and the compendium. move it with move huds.
tacklebox.config.questsAlign.desc: How the text of the quests left hud lines up inside it: left, centre or right.
tacklebox.config.boostsHud.desc: What is on right now: player boosters with a countdown, the chummer, and the weather events and moon. read from chat lines only. the server hud shows the events and moon too, switch its weather and moon lines off if you only want them here. move it with move huds.
tacklebox.config.boostsAlign.desc: How the text of the active boosts hud lines up inside it: left, centre or right.
tacklebox.config.levelBars.desc: Two thin bars: your fishing level (from the vanilla xp bar) and the level of the location you are at. the location bar starts when you open /comp once and then follows the location xp of quest rewards and chat. move it with move huds.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsHeading.desc: The green level progress title above the bars.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsLocation.desc: The bar for the location you are at.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsBar.desc: The thin bar itself. off leaves just the level, the percent and the location xp as text.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsXp.desc: The location xp into the level over what it needs, after the location bar.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsMainXp.desc: The xp into the fishing level over what it needs, after the fishing bar.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsDecimals.desc: Decimal places in the location xp, 367K instead of 367.27K.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsWidth.desc: How long the bars are, in pixels.
tacklebox.config.levelBarsAlign.desc: How the text of the level progress hud lines up inside it: left, centre or right.
tacklebox.config.nowPlaying.desc: Shows what is playing on your computer (spotify, youtube in a browser, anything that works with playerctl): title, artist and the time. linux only, needs playerctl installed. shows only, it never controls the player. move it with move huds.
tacklebox.config.nowPlayingHeading.desc: The green now playing title above the track.
tacklebox.config.nowPlayingArt.desc: The cover next to the text. it is fetched once per track from the address the player gives (spotify, youtube thumbnails).
tacklebox.config.nowPlayingArtist.desc: The artist or channel under the title.
tacklebox.config.nowPlayingBar.desc: A thin bar showing how far into the track you are. not shown for live streams.
tacklebox.config.nowPlayingTime.desc: The time played and the length of the track.
tacklebox.config.nowPlayingAlign.desc: How the text of the now playing hud lines up inside it: left, centre or right.
tacklebox.config.serverHud.desc: A sidebar styled hud: time, location, wallet and credits, the tackle shop and moon timers, and the weather events and moon that are active. move and resize it with move huds.
tacklebox.config.serverHudAlign.desc: How the text of the server hud (the title stays centred) lines up inside it: left, centre or right.
tacklebox.config.stillBobber.desc: Keeps your bobber still on the water. it still dips on a bite.
tacklebox.config.smoothCast.desc: On a laggy connection your cast flies smoothly instead of jumping back. the landing spot stays exact.
tacklebox.config.hideOtherBobbers.desc: Hides other players bobbers and their lines.
tacklebox.config.bobberSkin.desc: Swaps your bobber for a skin. only you see it.
tacklebox.config.skinEveryone.desc: Uses your skin on other players bobbers too, on your screen only.
tacklebox.config.lineColor.desc: The colour of your fishing line.
tacklebox.config.hideLoginChat.desc: Hides the welcome lines fishonmc prints every time you join: the instance, the fish and shader pack lines, the welcome, help, rules and discord lines.
tacklebox.config.hideEmptyChat.desc: Hides chat lines with nothing in them, the blank gaps the server sends around some messages. announcements lose their spacing lines too.
tacklebox.config.hideBehindChat.desc: Huds that would sit under the chat, a chat box or the player list are hidden while they overlap. off by default.
tacklebox.config.hideOwnNametag.desc: Hides the rank, name and power tag over your own head. others still see it.
tacklebox.config.hideAllNametags.desc: Hides every players nametag, the servers and the vanilla one.
tacklebox.config.hideXpPopups.desc: Hides the +66xp line above the hotbar after a catch.
tacklebox.config.flatLeaves.desc: Draws leaves flat like vanilla instead of the packs 3d leaves. reloads resources.
tacklebox.config.hideFarDisplays.desc: Stops drawing the servers item, block and text displays (spawn decor, shop signs, holograms) beyond the range below. at spawn this can double your fps. nearby ones stay.
tacklebox.config.farDisplayRange.desc: How far away displays still get drawn, in blocks. (blocks)
tacklebox.config.chummerRing.desc: Draws a thin ring on the ground at the range of every placed chummer your client can see, 20 blocks out. read from the chummer's hologram, not from chat.
tacklebox.config.chummerRingColor.desc: The colour of the chummer range ring.
